Kestrel Explorer

apt repository for Ubuntu 24.04 / Linux Mint 22 and newer (amd64). Source: github.com/RegulusArms/kes-c

Install

sudo install -d -m 755 /etc/apt/keyrings
sudo curl -fsSLo /etc/apt/keyrings/kestrel.asc https://regulusarms.github.io/kes-c/kestrel.asc
suite=$(. /etc/os-release; echo "${UBUNTU_CODENAME:-$VERSION_CODENAME}")
curl -fsIo /dev/null "https://regulusarms.github.io/kes-c/dists/$suite/InRelease" || suite=stable
sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/kestrel.sources >/dev/null <<EOF
Types: deb
URIs: https://regulusarms.github.io/kes-c
Suites: $suite
Components: main
Signed-By: /etc/apt/keyrings/kestrel.asc
EOF
sudo apt update && sudo apt install kestrel-explorer

The suite is your Ubuntu release's, read from /etc/os-release (UBUNTU_CODENAME, which Linux Mint and every Ubuntu flavour set, else VERSION_CODENAME): noble on Ubuntu 24.04 and Linux Mint 22, resolute on Ubuntu 26.04. On a release without its own suite it's stable, which has the same package. Then run kes, or open Kestrel Explorer from the app menu.

Development builds

For the latest build of the DEV branch instead, use your release's dev suite: the same commands with these two lines in place of the suite= ones (it's dev on a release without its own), then sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade.

suite=$(. /etc/os-release; echo "${UBUNTU_CODENAME:-$VERSION_CODENAME}-dev")
curl -fsIo /dev/null "https://regulusarms.github.io/kes-c/dists/$suite/InRelease" || suite=dev

Suites

SuiteForGets
noble, noble-devUbuntu 24.04, Linux Mint 22every release / development build
resolute, resolute-devUbuntu 26.04every release / development build
stable, devany releaseevery release / development build, for the newest supported releases only

When Kestrel stops supporting an Ubuntu release, its suites keep the last version that installs there and get no more builds; this page and the changelog say so. stable and dev move on to versions that may not install on it any more, so if your kestrel.sources says Suites: stable or dev (as it did before the release suites), run the commands above again to switch to your release's suite.

Remove

sudo apt remove kestrel-explorer
sudo rm /etc/apt/sources.list.d/kestrel.sources /etc/apt/keyrings/kestrel.asc
